headline: Approved June 8, 2026 minutes and planned table and flyer for October 3rd Methuen Day
summary: The Cultural Council approved amended minutes from June 8, 2026 and reviewed a financial update. Members discussed upcoming events, planned participation in Methuen Day on October 3rd, and finalized guidelines and priorities for the 2027 grant season.
decisions: Approved the June 8, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 6 yes, 1 absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to accept minutes as amended: Taana. Second: Olivia. Vote: 6 yes, 1 absent. Motion passed.

plain_text:
Methuen Cultural Council 2026   
   
Ellen Baranowski - Chair  
Olivia Chung - Member 
Taana Latu -Member   
Luis Sanchez - Member  
Carey Smith- Member   
Catherine Zembruski – Member  
  
 
  
Meeting Minutes 
Monday, August 10, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
     Location:  Nevins Memorial Library, Study Room  
1 Call to Order/Roll Call/Vote to Accept Agenda/Public Participation   
The meeting was called to order at 6:30 PM.  In attendance: Ellen Baranowski, Olivia Chung, 
Taana Latu, Carey Smith, Catherine Zembruski.  Absent: Luis Sanchez.  There was no public 
participation.                                      
 
2 Reading and Approval of Minutes- June 8, 2026 meeting    
Minutes were amended to change the date to June 8, 2026 (not 2025).  Motion to accept 
minutes as amended: Taana. Second: Olivia.  Vote: 6 yes, 1 absent.  Motion passed.    
                              
3 Financial Report- Update   Ellen shared an update of the 2026 finances with the group.

5 New Council Business 
Salma Boulal    
The question as to her membership status is in the hands of James McCarty and Mayor Beauregard 
October 3rd Methuen Day 10:00- 11:00-3:00 /Discussion and Schedule
The MCC will apply for a table at the event.   
Table schedule:  10:30-12:00- Taana and Ellen 
   12:00-1:30- Catherine and Luis 
  1:30-3:00- Carey and Ellen 
Following discussion, Olivia will create a short survey for the public to share their ideas of what they 
would like to see in Methuen around arts and cultural experiences.  Members of the Engagement and 
Outreach Committee will cull the data from that survey. 
 
August 28th Guidelines and Priorities Due to MA CC/Discussion 
Guidelines and Priorities were adjusted slightly to submit for 2027 
September 1-October 15   “2027 Grant Season” 
Taana created a great flyer that will be edited and shared with Ellen for copying (100 copies).  Hopefully, 
we can add QR Codes for the public to join us on Facebook and/or Instagram.  We will post at the library 
and City Hall.  We will have them on our table at Methuen Day.   We will share with City Council and 
School Committee, as well as the Methuen Superintendent’s Office. 
 
 
6 Engagement and Outreach Subcommittee Report  
Application Announcement Poster 
 
7 Announcements/Miscellaneous    
At our next meeting, we will do a quick review of the 2026 grants, in anticipation of the new grant 
season opening.     
                                                                         
8 Adjourn   
Motion to adjourn: Catherine. Second Taana.  Vote: 6 yes. 1 Absent.  Motion passed.   The meeting 
adjourned at 7:30 PM 
 
 
Next Regular Meeting:  September 14, 2026; 6:30 PM
